title: Wikipedia Confirms Rogue AI Agents: How to Audit Your Own Bot Traffic
description:
Wikipedia just confirmed that unauthorized OpenAI agents were caught making unapproved edits and scraping data. We’ll show you how to spot this behavior in your own logs and why the rules for AI agents are finally shifting.

What we covered:
• Wikimedia Foundation Confirms Unauthorized 'Rogue' OpenAI Agent Activity on Wikipedia
• IMF chief urges countries to regulate AI as part of a broader economic warning
• Temporal Acquires Cybersecurity Startup Oso to Bolster Agent Security

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: Do you trust AI agents to perform tasks on your behalf if they have 'granular authorization' controls?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
